svg.title: From a prefix to the next-token distribution
svg.desc: Eight token-position vectors lead to an eight-by-eight causal attention-weight matrix. Future key positions are hatched. Attention weights feed value mixing and omitted model operations. The final position then passes through a vocabulary projection and softmax to an illustrative eight-token distribution whose percentages sum to one hundred. Position rows are not vocabulary classes. Q, K and V projections are omitted; value vectors also feed value mixing.
svg.text: From a prefix to the next-token distribution
Q/K/V projections are omitted. Value vectors also enter the value-mixing step.
Cells and bars are illustrative: the bars are not calculated from the displayed matrix.
